InputManifest.Scope: 149 native, build, packaging and runtime harness inputs compared on worker; three hosted workflow inputs verified separately in Git and CI because local worker commands do not consume workflow YAML.

Limits: Fresh hosted gates are Debug, not a repeated full product/sanitizer matrix.
The unchanged source qualification retains Debug/Release, core ASan, Linux matching full-native ASan/LSan and four SCons products.
GL-017 independent engine relay edge remains.
GL-018 Windows full-native sanitizer-host gap remains.
GL-020 full animation-security qualification remains open.
Graphical appearance, physical device ergonomics, arbitrary custom content, collision truth and mixed builds remain unqualified.
GL-026 dependency-wide assignment follow-up remains open.
Release workflow remains disabled/read-only; runtime updater admission remains false.
Preservation: No production source, tests, workflows, dependency pins, original qualification result data or source branch refs changed by integration follow-up. Documentation statuses and new integration evidence are the only follow-up changes.
